description: Taxonomy of token-standard interaction surfaces (ERC1155 / ERC721 / ERC20 / custom wrappers). Drives token_standard_audit.py via token_standard_taxonomy.classify(). Surfaces token-standard SEMANTIC risk (receiver-revert DoS, mint-to-non-receiver stuck tokens, batch length mismatch, supply-vs-ownership accounting, operator bypass, cross-standard id confusion) — the class behind eval misses #272 (Fertilizer ERC1155 NFT loss) and #273 (ERC1155 mint DoS).
_fp_note: TIGHT by design (not a fishing expedition). Categories with require_standard_context=true only fire when the standard is positively inferred from the function-signature param SHAPE (ids/amounts->1155 batch; id+amount[+data]->1155; tokenId-only->721; amount-only->20) OR interface/inherit/file CONTEXT. Unique ERC1155 names (onERC1155Received, _doSafe*AcceptanceCheck, safeBatchTransferFrom, _mintBatch, setApprovalForAll, transferERC1155) fire context-free. Bare generic words (deposit/withdraw/wrap/transfer/balanceOf/approve/permit) are intentionally NOT patterns — they pervade Beanstalk's Silo/Field domain and are not token-standard surfaces. Event matching is case-sensitive word-boundary (so 'LibTransfer.To' does NOT match 'Transfer').

erc1155_acceptance_check.review_hint: ERC1155 acceptance-check CALLER. THE #273 DoS VECTOR: a recipient that reverts or returns a wrong selector blocks the mint/transfer. 'Verbatim OZ copy' is NOT a clear — can a protocol mint/transfer be DoS'd by a hostile/incompatible receiver?

erc1155_receiver_callback.review_hint: ERC1155 receiver-callback IMPLEMENTATION (this contract receives tokens). Returns the correct magic selector? Can it revert and trap tokens? Unsafe reentrant logic on receipt? (Distinct from the acceptance-check caller.)

erc1155_batch_transfer.review_hint: ERC1155 batch transfer. Validate ids.length == amounts.length; receiver-DoS; operator auth; per-id balance updates before the batch acceptance callback.

erc1155_transfer.review_hint: ERC1155 single transfer (5-arg safeTransferFrom(from,to,id,amount,data)). Receiver-revert DoS; stuck tokens; operator/approval check; balance updated before the external acceptance callback. Disambiguated from ERC20/721 by param shape.

erc1155_batch_mint.review_hint: ERC1155 batch mint. ids.length == amounts.length; receiver-DoS / stuck-token / supply-accounting across the batch.

erc1155_mint.review_hint: ERC1155 single mint. Malicious/contract receiver revert or wrong selector to DoS the mint? Mint to a non-ERC1155Receiver contract -> stuck? Supply accounting consistent before the external acceptance callback (reentrancy)? Disambiguated by 1155 shape/context.

erc1155_batch_burn.review_hint: ERC1155 batch burn. Array lengths; authorization; per-id supply/balance consistency.

erc1155_burn.review_hint: ERC1155 burn. Caller authorized (owner/operator)? Supply decremented consistently with balance? Over-burn underflow?

erc1155_supply_accounting.review_hint: ERC1155 supply/balance hook. Per-id supply consistent with balances after mint/burn/transfer? Does _beforeTokenTransfer keep external accounting (e.g. Fertilizer bpf/owed) in sync? Mismatch -> NFT loss / mis-accounting (#272 class).

erc1155_token_id_accounting.review_hint: ERC1155 token-id derivation. Id miscomputed, reused, or confused across id spaces? (Only in a standard-call context — a bare local 'id' is not this.)

erc1155_approval_for_all.review_hint: ERC1155 operator approval. Operator permissions set/bypassed incorrectly? Transfer path's approval check consistent with isApprovedForAll? Self-approval edge cases?

erc1155_uri_metadata.review_hint: ERC1155 URI/metadata. Metadata-only — NOT transfer/mint/supply risk unless setURI is unauthorized or mutates state. Confirm access control on setters only.

erc721_mint.review_hint: ERC721 safe mint. onERC721Received acceptance DoS; mint-to-non-receiver stuck. Distinct from ERC1155 (no amount arg).

erc721_transfer.review_hint: ERC721 transfer (3-arg safeTransferFrom(from,to,tokenId)). Approval/operator auth; receiver acceptance DoS. Disambiguated from ERC1155 (no amount) / ERC20 (no id).

erc721_receiver_callback.review_hint: ERC721 receiver-callback implementation. Returns correct selector? Reverts trapping tokens?

erc20_transfer.review_hint: ERC20 transfer (transferFrom(from,to,amount) / safeTransfer, no id). Return-value check (SafeERC20)? Fee-on-transfer/rebasing accounting? Lowest-priority standard; only when no ERC1155/721 context.

erc20_approval.review_hint: ERC20 approval. Approve-race / non-zero-to-non-zero; return-value handling.

custom_wrapper.review_hint: Custom wrapper that internally drives a standard token (e.g. Internalizer over Fertilizer1155). Correctly bridges accounting between wrapper and the underlying standard? Assumes ERC20 (amount-only) semantics for an ERC1155 (id+amount)?

cross_standard_confusion.review_hint: Generic token-support / multi-standard transfer entrypoint (e.g. TokenSupportFacet.transferERC1155). Correct standard interface for the token? Could an ERC1155 be moved with ERC20/721 semantics (wrong arity, missing id/amount, missing acceptance check)? Arbitrary external token contracts callable here (reentrancy)?
